node_definition.done_when: tests/test_a_local_worker_is_named_its_images.py passes: a launch_plan for a claude-family backend that declares image input, given one image, carries a prompt that names that image's path and tells the worker to open it with its Read tool, and does not raise; _backend_settings in reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py, for a record whose argv is recorded under a config whose lane declares image input, returns that input_modalities declaration, and the resume launch built from it names the image rather than refusing it; the same launch for a claude-family backend that declares no image input still refuses by name; a launch given no image carries the prompt as today. Resolving docs/state/reckon/flight.yaml with an empty host layer declares image input on clive as well as codex, and not on the claude lane, held by tests/test_codex_declares_image_input.py. With a flight where clive is the only lane declaring image input, the figure-review lane candidates from _review_lane_candidates(config, profile='figure') include clive. The tests that asserted the clive refusal, in tests/test_dispatch_attaches_the_figures.py and the clive case of test_a_lane_that_cannot_carry_the_figure_refuses_by_name in tests/test_launch_plan_attaches_images.py, now give that backend a declaration and assert the named path, while undeclared lanes still refuse; tests/test_dispatch_attaches_the_figures.py keeps a dispatch-level refusal case beside the new naming case, on the claude lane, which stays undeclared, so the dispatch still refuses an undeclared lane by name. The change keys on the backend's input_modalities, not on the dialect, since clive and the claude lane share one dialect; the codex dialect's -i behaviour is unchanged, and an undeclared codex backend still emits -i, as tests/test_launch_plan_attaches_images.py asserts. The test files build their flight and stores in a temporary directory and read nothing outside it. ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on changed Python files. Every log is written under the run directory, starts with its revision and the literal command, and ends in EXIT=. The coordinator runs the importer population of reckon/_backends.py and reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py at merge; do not run a base arm
